query: SELECT vt.*, tm.name as memberName, tm.role as memberRole, tm.type as memberType, v.name as ventureName FROM venture_team vt LEFT JOIN team_members tm ON vt.memberId = tm.id LEFT JOIN ventures v ON vt.ventureId = v.id LIMIT 20;
